project_description: A web-based application to digitize and streamline the process of employees applying for leave and managers reviewing/approving these requests, replacing manual tracking.

executive_summary.project_overview: The Employee Leave Management System is a web-based application designed to centralize and automate leave requests and approvals for employees and managers.
executive_summary.business_problem: Current leave tracking relies on manual processes, leading to inefficiencies, paperwork, and potential errors in managing employee leave requests and balances.
executive_summary.business_need: There is a need for a digital, centralized solution to simplify leave applications, maintain accurate leave balances, and provide efficient approval workflows for managers.
executive_summary.proposed_solution: A secure, role-based web application with modules for employees to apply for leave, managers to approve/reject requests, and HR to manage policies and accounts.
business_benefits: Reduced manual paperwork and administrative overhead.
Improved accuracy and transparency in leave balance management.
executive_summary.expected_outcome: A streamlined, efficient, and transparent leave management process that enhances employee satisfaction and reduces operational costs.

epics.title: Employee Self-Service Leave Management
epics.description: Enable employees to independently manage their leave requests, view balances, and track their leave history through a user-friendly interface.
epics.business_value: High - Empowers employees and reduces administrative burden on managers/HR.

epics.title: Administrative Leave Workflow & Configuration
epics.description: Provide managers and HR administrators with tools to review, approve, reject leave requests, manage employee accounts, and configure leave policies.
epics.business_value: High - Ensures compliance, efficient decision-making, and system configurability.

features.title: Leave Application and Tracking
features.description: Allows employees to apply for various types of leave, specify dates and reasons, and track the status of their requests.
acceptance_criteria: Employee can select leave type, dates, and provide a reason.
Employee can view the current status of submitted leave requests.

features.title: Employee Leave Information Access
features.description: Enables employees to securely log in, view their available leave balances, and access their complete leave history.
acceptance_criteria: Employee can securely log into their account.
Employee can view their current leave balance for all leave types.

features.title: Managerial Leave Request Processing
features.description: Provides managers with the ability to view, approve, or reject pending leave requests from their direct reports, including adding comments.
acceptance_criteria: Manager can see a list of all pending leave requests.
Manager can approve or reject a request and add comments for rejection.

features.title: HR System Administration and Reporting
features.description: Allows HR administrators to manage employee accounts, update leave policies, adjust leave balances, and generate organization-wide leave reports.
acceptance_criteria: HR can create and modify employee accounts.
HR can generate reports on organization-wide leave data.

stories.title: Apply for New Leave
stories.i_want: to apply for a new leave request
stories.so_that: my manager can review and approve it.
acceptance_criteria: I can select a leave type (e.g., sick, vacation).
I can specify start and end dates for my leave.

stories.title: View My Leave History and Status
stories.i_want: to view my past and pending leave requests
stories.so_that: I can keep track of my leave usage and upcoming time off.
acceptance_criteria: I can see a list of all my submitted leave requests.
Each request shows its current status (e.g., pending, approved, rejected).

stories.title: Secure Employee Login
stories.i_want: to log in securely to the system
stories.so_that: I can access my leave information and apply for leave.
acceptance_criteria: I can enter my credentials (username/password) to log in.
The system authenticates my identity and grants access to my module.

stories.title: View Available Leave Balance
stories.i_want: to view my current leave balances
stories.so_that: I know how much leave I have available before applying.
acceptance_criteria: I can see my remaining balance for each leave type.
The balance is updated in real-time based on approved/pending requests.

stories.title: Approve or Reject Leave Requests
stories.i_want: to review and act on pending leave requests from my team
stories.so that: I can manage my team's availability and ensure business continuity.
acceptance_criteria: I can view details of each pending leave request.
I can choose to 'Approve' or 'Reject' a request, adding comments if rejecting.

stories.title: View Employee Leave Records
stories.i_want: to view the leave history of my direct reports
stories.so that: I can make informed decisions when approving new leave requests.
acceptance_criteria: I can search for and view an employee's past leave requests.
The history includes leave type, dates, and approval status.

stories.title: Manage Employee Accounts and Balances
stories.i_want: to create new employee accounts and update leave balances
stories.so that: I can onboard new staff and maintain accurate leave records.
acceptance_criteria: I can create a new employee account with basic details.
I can manually adjust an employee's leave balance for any leave type.

stories.title: Generate Organization-Wide Leave Reports
stories.i_want: to generate reports on organization-wide leave data
stories.so that: I can analyze leave trends and ensure compliance with policies.
acceptance_criteria: I can select criteria (e.g., date range, department) for reports.
The system generates a report showing aggregated leave data.

tasks.title: Design Leave Application Form UI
tasks.description: Create the user interface for employees to input leave type, dates, and reason.

tasks.title: Implement Leave Request Submission Logic
tasks.description: Develop backend logic to process and store new leave requests in the database.

tasks.title: Develop Leave History Display Component
tasks.description: Build the frontend component to display a list of an employee's past and pending leave requests.

tasks.title: Integrate Leave History Data Retrieval
tasks.description: Implement API endpoint and logic to fetch an employee's complete leave history from the database.

tasks.title: Implement User Authentication Service
tasks.description: Develop the backend service for user login, including password hashing and token generation.

tasks.title: Design and Build Login Page UI
tasks.description: Create the responsive user interface for the login page.

tasks.title: Develop Leave Balance Display Component
tasks.description: Build the UI component to show an employee's current leave balances for different types.

tasks.title: Implement Leave Balance Calculation Logic
tasks.description: Develop the backend logic to calculate and retrieve accurate, real-time leave balances.

tasks.title: Build Pending Requests List for Managers
tasks.description: Develop the UI component to display a list of pending leave requests assigned to a manager.

tasks.title: Implement Approve/Reject Request Logic
tasks.description: Develop backend API endpoints and logic for managers to approve or reject requests, including adding comments.

tasks.title: Develop Employee Leave History View for Managers
tasks.description: Build the UI component allowing managers to view the leave history of their direct reports.

tasks.title: Implement Managerial Access to Employee Leave Data
tasks.description: Develop backend logic to fetch and display specific employee leave history for authorized managers.

tasks.title: Develop Employee Account Creation Form
tasks.description: Build the UI for HR administrators to create new employee accounts.

tasks.title: Implement Leave Balance Update Functionality
tasks.description: Develop backend logic and API for HR to manually adjust an employee's leave balance.

tasks.title: Design Report Generation Interface
tasks.description: Create the UI for HR to select report criteria and initiate report generation.

tasks.title: Implement Organization-Wide Leave Report Logic
tasks.description: Develop backend service to query and aggregate leave data based on selected criteria and generate reports.
